verdict.rationale: LanceDB has dedicated metadata filtering docs and supports predicate pushdown, which is corroborated independently by a community comment praising the pushdown implementation for efficient filtering. This directly addresses filtering without recall/latency degradation via native pushdown rather than post-filtering. Missing for 10: quantitative benchmarks showing recall/latency impact of filtered vs unfiltered search, and more detailed docs on pre- vs post-filtering tradeoffs.
